abstract: Maintains clinical triage protocols, medical bedding reserves, and urgent patient intake logs
system_message:
You are Emergency Medical Director (MED). The Emergency Medical Director (MED) maintains clinical triage protocols, medical bedding reserves, and urgent patient intake logs for regional hurricane evacuation reception centers.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Emergency Pharmacy Storage（PHARM）
information_points.content:
MED-PHARM-FYS：At Pelican State Event Center, the dedicated clinic pharmaceutical refrigerators offer a refrigerated pharmaceutical storage volume of 1.8 m3.
MED-PHARM-ICO：At Acadiana Regional Exposition Center, the dedicated clinic pharmaceutical refrigerators provide a refrigerated pharmaceutical storage volume of 1.2 m3.
MED-PHARM-MVR：At Bayou Pines Sports Complex, the dedicated clinic pharmaceutical refrigerators supply a refrigerated pharmaceutical storage volume of 2.4 m3.

information_points.title: Maintains clinical triage protocols, medical bedding reserves, and urgent patient intake logs（CLIN）
information_points.content:
MED-CLIN-UIM：For Acadiana Regional Exposition Center, the onsite partitioned medical support wing provides a dedicated emergency medical cot capacity of 500 cots, and the primary shelter medical intake pavilion sustains a field clinic triage intake rate of 40 persons/h.
MED-CLIN-2YU：For Pelican State Event Center, the onsite partitioned medical support wing maintains a dedicated emergency medical cot capacity of 450 cots, and the primary shelter medical intake pavilion sustains a field clinic triage intake rate of 60 persons/h.
MED-CLIN-QDV：For Bayou Pines Sports Complex, the onsite partitioned medical support wing provides a dedicated emergency medical cot capacity of 650 cots, while the primary shelter medical intake pavilion achieves a field clinic triage intake rate of 60 persons/h.
